I submitted the verdict as verified: the finding stands.

The comment at `cptra_smoke_test_mcu_mbox_pass_data.c:365` says the MCU side will check that the lock-request interrupt is set. Nothing on the MCU side does that. `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_pass_data.c` never calls the library helper that waits for the interrupt, and it has no interrupt or ISR references.

Two other tests do use that helper, `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_target_user` and `smoke_test_mcu_hitless`, so the pass_data test is the one missing the check. Test-plan item p6.k1 (SOC request interrupt is set) is therefore never checked by this test.
